title: Yara and the Landfall
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Rosalind Joubert, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
